build_vit_encoder: build a Vision Transformer image encoder from timm with a specified architecture and global pooling strategy
build_vit_with_sincos_pos: build a ViT encoder using fixed 2D sine-cosine position embeddings instead of learned ones
build_vit_with_grad_checkpointing: build a ViT image encoder with gradient checkpointing enabled to reduce memory usage
create_mocov3_vit_small: create a small Vision Transformer with 12 heads as used by MoCo-v3 for better performance
build_vit_avg_pooling: build a ViT encoder using global average pooling instead of the CLS token for feature extraction
